title: Chawanprash Avaleha
description: Chawanprash Avaleha (Chawanprash Special) is the most well-known Ayurvedic multi-herbal jam, utilizing fresh Amla pulp as its base combined with over 40 powerful herbs. This supreme formulation is a supreme daily immunomodulator strengthening immune function. Guards against seasonal respiratory infections through immune enhancement. Delays aging and age-related degeneration through rejuvenative action. Enhances overall strength and vitality.
dosage: 1 to 2 teaspoons (10–20 grams) daily, best taken in the morning with warm milk
